name: shaft-plaza
title: City-Shaft plaza paving
judgement: The slabs read slightly raised: each stone's edge toward the sun takes a pale lip, the edge away a soft shade beside its joint. Quiet at full size, clear in the close-up; no new lines.
view: Pinned camera: eye [280, 203.4, -6], target [283, 200, -16], fov 55; noon, clear.

name: aerie-hall
title: The Aerie: a hall's panels and floor plates
patterns: machined finish (engraved borders, sockets, set-back panels)
judgement: Faint. The floor plates' inlaid borders get a pale far lip and the sockets a lit rim; the wall panels barely change (on a temple wall the relief only knows the sun's height, not its run along the wall, so side edges get nothing). Harmless, but you have to look for it.
view: Pinned camera: eye [-395, 1639.8, -736], target [-395, 1640.5, -730.3], fov 60; noon, clear.

name: foundry-walls
title: Moon Foundry riveted walls
judgement: On the upper box the horizontal seams pick up a lit top edge, so the plates read lapped. Rivets are left as they were here: on rivets this small the shade crescent was inked into smudges, so the relief only draws round rivets at least ~1.6 px across (close up).
view: Pinned camera: eye [-87.77, 4, -28.98], target [-95.9, 1.2, -40.38], fov 55; noon, clear.

name: lorn-timber
title: Lorn's timber walkway
judgement: Next to nothing: Lorn's dark planks and their grain leave the arris light lost in the hatching. Not worth it here; costs nothing either.
view: Pinned camera: eye [24, 3.0, -745], target [14, 1.0, -755], fov 55; noon, clear.

name: lorn-stone
title: Lorn's pale stone (the Hush-House)
judgement: The blocks read proud of their joints: a pale line along each block's top, a soft shade under the joint above. Gentle and in the house style.
view: Pinned camera: eye [-108, 5, 109], target [-130, 5.5, 104], fov 55; noon, clear.

name: dunes-city
title: Glass Dunes buried city (the clock drum)
judgement: The wind bands read as cut grooves: a shade just above each line, a pale lip below. An earlier, stronger version doubled the lines into dashes (post.js inked the shade); the strength is now capped per channel, and only a faint flicker is left on the lowest band.
view: Pinned camera: eye [662, 2603.5, -640], target [643, 2607, -625], fov 55; noon, clear.

name: vael-table
title: Vael's table rock top
judgement: The long fissure reads as cut in places, but its shaded wall is partly inked as a second thin line beside it, so in spots it looks like a doubled pen line. The crackle net and pebbles are unchanged.
view: Pinned camera: eye [-5, 73, -425], target [-30, 69, -455], fov 55; noon, clear.

name: shop
title: A shop's interior
judgement: The clearest case: every floor tile reads as a slightly raised tile, a pale far edge and a shaded near one beside its grout.
view: Pinned camera: eye [-903, 3001.6, 903], target [-898, 3000.2, 898], fov 60; noon, clear.
